realTerrain.source: NOAA ETOPO2022; terrain only. Routing is our derivation, not a measured river map.

controlMethod: Same fine heights and outlet positions/levels; remove inherited catchment masks. Unit supply per fine cell, which does not affect routing-head calculation. This control does not compare physical water budgets.
adoptionDecision: Do not promote nearest-parent catchment masking as a finished physical watershed model. It preserves outlet budgets but increases routing obstructions on the real DEM. Shared context, fine views and persistence are reusable.
limitations: Parent outlet identity and annual budgets are preserved
Fine drainage is recomputed inside inherited catchments
Catchment divides are nearest-parent membership and remain provisional at subcell scale
Combined parent source budget is redistributed; this does not invent fine rainfall data
Routing fill is not ground or a physical lake
The outer context remains unresolved if the parent was unresolved
No new terrain is added when using interpolation; independently generated adjacent contexts are not certified
nextStep: Retain downstream destination constraints but refine watershed divides with terrain rather than copying parent cell ownership. Any resulting boundary-budget change must be reconciled before committing neighbours.
